notes.title: A Massive Quality of Life Update!
notes.notes:
[b]If you want just a quick summary[/b]
[list]
[*] The workshop is now functional!!
[*] The Maze is a little easier and now has a sprint.
[*] The game and DLC is 30% off!
[*] [url=https://huntedmedia.shop/products/toilet-flushing-simulator-stickers] TOILET FLUSHING SIMULATOR STICKERS ARE AVAILABLE NOW![/url]
[/list]

[b]STEAM SALE TIMES 30% OFF THE GAME AND THE DLC!![/b]

[h1]The Workshop [i]SHOULD[/i] work now![/h1]
I have completely re-worked The Workshop connection from the ground up and after some testing it seems to be working on multiple devices now so hopefully it finally works now! I also added arrows that are labeled int the order things must be done in for a successful workshop submission so it should be easier to understand now!

[h1]The Maze is no longer stupidly difficult![/h1]
I have been tweaking The Maze since it came out to make it a little bit more fair for the player, I fell into the trap early on of testers and I getting use to the maze so not struggling despite how difficult it truly is. Now the player has a short sprint to quickly escape the monster when being chased and the monster is practically dumber now so it easier to lose the monster after it spots you.

This is probably going to be the last update as I am trying to work on newer projects, It's been almost 2 years, so to celebrate this last update....

[h1][b]TOILET FLUSHING SIMULATOR STICKERS ARE NOW AVAILABLE!![/b][/h1]
At the same time this update comes out, on my store ( https://huntedmedia.shop/products/toilet-flushing-simulator-stickers ) will be available!! there is a unique sticker of all the base toilets in the game and the monster! available in regular and holographic forms!! 

Thank you all so much for the support over the past 2 years, it has been so fun working on this game all this time. hopefully you are all as excited for new projects as I am!

notes.title: The Lore Update!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Look! I added more stuff again![/h1][/b]
It's been a little while since an update so here we are, a lot of new stuff too!

[b][h2]First the Toilets[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] The Australian Toilet
[*] The Tank Toilet
[*] The Hole Toilet
[/list]

[b][h2]Secondly[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] NFT flushable (Hunted Media in no way supports NFTs at all, this was added purely to make fun of NFTs)
[/list]

[b][h2]Finally the big thing![/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] The Log
[/list]

The Log is accessible from the main menu and includes descriptions for EVERY item in the game. All flushable descriptions can be accessed immediately however, Toilet descriptions will require you to have unlocked the toilet in the base game!

I also fixed a little UI issue annoying me when I noticed it with the colour of the texts on the buttons not being the same on every button.

I hope everyone enjoys reading through the stupid descriptions I wrote for everything and also enjoy the new content added!

notes.title: A little bug fix and annoucnements
notes.notes:
Just another little update fixing some random things I missed before
[list]
[*] using the back button on the pause menu wouldn't bring back the shop buttons in the base game or arcade mode
[*] (more of a QOL improvement) the leaderboard was hard to read if the toilet shop was open when the round ended
[/list]

However the more important part of these patch notes is the announcements 

[h3]Firstly[/h3]

You can now listen to the entire Toilet Flushing Simulator Soundtrack on spotify!
https://twitter.com/ToiletSimulator/status/1512753697893232641?s=20&t=zYP524t-5WxbMUc4bDM-uA
If you ever wanted to be questioned not only for owning this game but actively listening to the soundtrack now you can!

[h3]Secondly[/h3]

YOU can contribute to the next major content update of Toilet Flushing Simulator by leaving your suggestions in the reply to the linked tweet below!
https://twitter.com/ToiletSimulator/status/1508782887377637377?s=20&t=zYP524t-5WxbMUc4bDM-uA
I already have a little list from recommendations so I decided to make the tweet to help collect more in a single place instead of searching the internet for what you all want!

[h3]Finally[/h3]

I just want to say thank you to everyone who has played this dumb meme game, this only exists because of stupid joke someone said to me and because of all of you, it has evolved into the game we all have today. I didn't think I would still be working on more stuff for this game but seeing people actually playing and enjoying this has inspired me to keep working on it, and has helped me stay inspired to work on other projects. So thank you all for wasting a dollar on the stupidest game on steam.

notes.title: The Arcade Update!
notes.notes:
[b]It's time for a brand new major update![/b]
And this update is probably the biggest shake up to the game yet!

[b]So what's new?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Arcade Mode[/b]
Arcade mode is a high score based game mode that challenges you to get the best score possible in just 5 minutes!
Arcade mode also includes new chip-tune renditions of a large portion of the game's music with a brand new chip-tune track on top!
Arcade mode also includes 3 brand new achievements (bringing the total to 20) related to obtaining all the bonuses in one playthrough!
Arcade mode also includes a global leaderboard to compete against others for the best score!
[*] A brand new Arcade room has been added to the base game!
[/list]

On top of this a couple little bug fixes are included in this update like fixing all the festive toilet hitboxes so that flushables actually collide with them!

This update took a lot of hard work and a lot of testing to get everything working right so I hope everyone has fun and I am excited to see all your scores on the leaderboard!

notes.title: The Workshop Update!
notes.notes:
[b]The Toilet Flushing Simulator Workshop Update is finally finished![/b]
After a month and a half of development (almost double the time it took to make the base game!) players of Toilet Flushing Simulator can now officially upload and download custom flushables!

[b]What else is new?[/b]
[list]
[*]A new menu where you can upload your workshop items with its own unique song!
[*]A new shop in the main game where you can buy the downloaded workshop items! (all custom items are actually free!)
[*]2 New tracks for the main game!
[*]The "Festive" section of the flushables has been relabeled to "bonus" with a new item!
[/list]

This update has caused me so much trouble throughout all of the development and I think from now on it will most likely be small fixes for this update if any issues arise. If you encounter any bugs please start a discussion on the community page of Toilet Flushing Simulator!

The next major update won't be out for a long time now and I am going to take a break from this project for at least a month, hopefully after that I will be able to come up with more fun and unique content to add to this game!

notes.title: The Festive Update
notes.notes:
[b]The First Major Content Update has finally been released!![/b]

Included in this update is a few new things including...

[list]
[*] A New tab system in the shops
[*] completely updated all button prompts to be more visually understandable
[*] 3 New Toilets!
[*] 3 New achievements!
[*] 4 New flushables, 2 with unique features!
[*] A Brand new shop that allows you to change the room!
[*] 3 New rooms to flush toilets in
[/list]

With all this being finally added to the game there is just that little bit more to play with while the next updates are in the works, Hopefully There will be another big update next month! probably a little further into the month as the next planned update will introduce the Steam Workshop which is a very weird system to work with but I will hopefully have it ready for release before the end of the year!
